mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, p.title, ds.mode, p.share_round_no, p.summary_card, p.share_body, u.nickname AS author_nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count, p.vote_option_a, p.vote_option_b, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id AND pv.choice = 'A') AS vote_count_a, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id AND pv.choice = 'B') AS vote_count_b, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id AND pv.choice = 'A') * 1000.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id)) / 10.0 END AS vote_ratio_a, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id AND pv.choice = 'B') * 1000.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_votes pv WHERE pv.post_id = p.id)) / 10.0 END AS vote_ratio_b, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, debate_session_id, user_id, share_round_no, title, summary_card, share_body, vote_option_a, vote_option_b, is_public, created_at, updated_at FROM posts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT FROM posts p JOIN debate_sessions ds ON ds.id = p.debate_session_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM posts p JOIN debate_sessions ds ON ds.id = p.debate_session_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.is_public = TRUE
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.summary_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.share_body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ds.topic LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ds.mode = #{mode}
ORDER BY comment_count DESC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY (vote_count_a + vote_count_b) DESC, p.created_at DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_votes (post_id, user_id, choice) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{choice}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE choice = VALUES(choice), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
